title: Human bottleneck reset event 70,000 years ago
summary: Jack tells of Human bottleneck reset event 70,000 years ago, about c. 70,000 years ago at Earth, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Well, there there are people who feel strongly that there have been reset events, right? Human history reset events. For instance, 70,000 years ago, we know genomically there was a bottleneck.

plain: A podcast co-host named Jack says that some people firmly believe human history has been "reset" more than once, with civilization wiped out and starting over. As one example he points to roughly 70,000 years ago, when, he says, our genes show the human population shrank to a very small number, what scientists call a bottleneck. If that was a reset, it would mean humans may have lost a history we no longer remember.
